function.name: store_unit_new_customer
function.description: Use this tool for storing new unit (vehicle) information of new customer to the database.

chassis_type.description: The type of vehicle chassis (e.g., truck, trailer).

company_name.description: The company name of the caller.

email_address.description: The email address of the caller.

first_name.description: The first name of the caller.

last_name.description: The last name of the caller.

license_plate_state.description: The state of issuance for the license plate (e.g., 'CA').

unit_nickname.description: A friendly name or nickname for the vehicle.

unit_number.description: The new unit number to assign to the vehicle.

unit_subtype.description: The specific subtype of the unit (e.g., dry van, reefer).
